notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/f73c7a433733ac9a1e54dc6a155247a36496a9c1.jpg

Dear CEOs!
Do your New Year Resolutions include sending a rocket with your name on it into space? Well then, now is a great time to get back to Space Company Simulator! The new patch concentrates on fixing bugs reported by the community. 

You can check the full list of the changes below.

In addition, the game is now 30% off. Get Space Company Simulator by January 22 to become the best CEO in the space transportation industry. 

And if you like the changes, please consider dropping us a review or updating your previous one. They help us understand if we’re going in the right direction. Thanks!

Changelog:

 Fixed a bug where the “Space Program Mars'' building wasn’t necessary to finish the game. What, did you really think it was that easy?
 Fixed a bug where players could enter the Mission Control Center while the administration window was open.
 Astronauts now have a unique picture. 
 Events from the lower calendar now disappear while a player skips turns. Like they should. Let’s keep the calendar in order.
 Fixed the placeholder amounts in Weekly Revenue and Weekly Installments in Loans.
 Decision emails now make you gain or lose money. Do you feel the pressure of being a CEO yet?
 Full UI elements added to the Test Center.
 Fixed the text under Company Motto in the main menu.
 Buying the perks for Small Rocket “Dog-9”, Small Rocket “Hound-7”, or Medium Rocket “Space Explorer” MR-1 now unlocks the blueprints correctly. Try it!
 Fixed a bug where the particle system wouldn’t turn off after a rocket’s launch.
 Added missing descriptions of construction conditions to the Building map.
 The game no longer freezes when players access the Assembly Room.
 UI symbols of the settings menu now appear after players change the language to Polish.
 Fixed the marking of the Small Launcher building.
 There are no longer visual graphical artifacts on the building mode icon.

You can discuss the new changes and share your feedback with us in Steam Discussions and on Discord. 

Now let’s get ready for the lift off!

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/72123fab563464ba2baeeb5341d99f05e455cdad.jpg

Dear Space CEOs!
We’re back with a new update and a sale! Get Space Company Simulator before November 12 and reach the stars with a 30% discount to lighten your load!

The new update features major some upgrades to overall performance, many bug fixes including the Cash Overflow bug, and a completely redesigned UI! A full list of changes can be found below.

We know it’s been a while, so we would like to thank you for your patience while we were working on this update and hope that you’ll enjoy all the improvements.

Please give the new Update a try and let us know what you think! Your feedback helps us more than you think.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/29ddc5421c52f627d5dc2534b6d953a32b13214b.jpg
Contracts are waiting for you in the inbox, Boss!

Main features:
 Major performance improvements
 Implemented transition of render from HDRP (High Definition Render Pipeline) to URP (Universal Render Pipeline) in the Unity Engine
 Fixed variable overflow (including cash overflow)
 Reconfigured particle systems and shaders for URP in Rocket Launch
 Converted the space environment of the Solar system to URP render
 Improved post processing settings in the space environment of the Solar system
 Redesigned and implemented the left navigation menu inside buildings
 Reworked and integrated the windows of contracts
 Reworked the timeline bar
 Implemented the logic of scheduled launch dates on the timeline
 Implemented technologies’ colors indicating current status
 Implemented requirements for the construction of buildings
 Implemented descriptions of buildings’ functionality
 Reconfigured elements of visual effects: clouds, terrain, lightning, and more
 Reworked and integrated the UI of the inner block window in the building mode tree
 Reworked and integrated the UI of the building mode tree
 Reworked and integrated the UI of the perks tree for all departments
 Reworked and integrated the UI of the inner block windows for the HR, PR, Finance, and Production trees
 Reworked and integrated the UI of game events
 Reworked and integrated icons for events
 Improved and integrated the work of Events
 Implemented new UX logic for new art elements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/62267eb9caf3a8b221bcdd06c4582ecc9d4b1d7a.jpg
T - 3… 2… 1… Liftoff!

Bug fixes:
 Fixed the issue with the build freezing when creating a new game after completing the construction of any building
 Fixed the issue with pictured buildings not being visible on the constructed building icons
 Fixed the issue with duplicating pop-up’s logic of "Human Resources 2" building
 Fixed the issue of an incorrect pop-up saying "Public relations 2" building after completing construction
 Fixed the issue with the titles "Medium depot" and "Big depot" disappearing after building the big depot
 Fixed the issue with incorrect pop-up of the "Medium depot" building after completing its construction  
 Fixed the issue with an incorrect image on the "Medium launcher" building pop-up
 Fixed the issue with the "Medium launcher" building icon being displayed incorrectly after completing construction 
 Fixed the issue with the "Medium launcher" building having an incorrect pop-up after completing construction
 Fixed the issue of the progress not being displayed in the pop-up of a building icon in building mode
 Fixed the issue of the missing "Mission Control" building pop-up menu 
 Fixed the issue with the change of day and night by skipping a turn
 Fixed the issue with the tree trunks not being displayed
 Fixed the issue with employee images being displayed too early when starting a new game
 Fixed the issue with green elements being reflected in the pop-up window of a building that hasn’t been built yet
 Fixed the issue of the space environment of the Solar system not having any texture
 Fixed the issue with the shader of foliage trees 
 Fixed more lighting issues
 And more!

Known issues:
 The menus and windows of buildings in the Events window overlap the icon of events on the timeline
 The percentage progression on the Research tree icons for the Science department is displayed incorrectly

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/e132391cb5deab4dd96a345d9e946c13fdbb182e.jpg
The schedule is packed with events. It's going to be an interesting year!

Feedback
Once you give the new Update a try, let us know what you think! We’re especially curious to discover how much you like the new UI and how you feel about the game’s performance improvements. Share your impressions in Steam Discussions and on our Discord server.

If you like the game and the new changes, please also consider dropping us a review on Steam. They help us a lot!

Stay on course and aim for the stars!

Dear Space CEOs!
We're still working on changes to make Space Company Simulator top of the line. In this patch, we focused mainly on the aspects of rocket assembly, but we’ve also taken care of many other issues. Here’s the full list of changes:

Changelog

🔧 ASSEMBLY:
 Fixed the issue with the second Engine slot disappearing
 Fixed the issue with the Rocket Tank slot being active when placing Struts
 Component slots are no longer covered by the Inventory tab
 Fixed the issue with exceeding the allowed threshold of components which distorted other values in the Technical Overview tab 
 Fixed the incorrect display of component size information (S / M / L) which prevented components from being placed in corresponding slots 
 Sandbox Assembly: Thumbnail preview at rocket startup updates correctly
 Fixed the issue with disappearing component slot names
 Fixed the issue with inability to produce more components in a single turn after already commissioning the production of a certain component
 Fixed the issue with “Launch the rocket” and “Abort” buttons appearing in the Assembly after pressing certain keys
 Improved component grouping in the Inventory

⚙ SETTINGS:
 Fixed the issue with the game switching to Windowed mode after selecting any game mode
 Fixed the issue with incorrect save data in Save & Load panels
 Fixed the issue with the save button constantly remaining active in the graphic settings
 Fixed the issue with settings not refreshing despite the changes
 Fixed the issue whereby Windowed mode would activate when opening the Settings menu

📈 PERKS:
 Fixed the issue with the value of Perk points gain and money loss not updating after skipping turns or reloading the game
 Fixed the issue with the Second Child and Apple of My Eye Perks which prevented players from buying more Perks
 Fixed the issue with Perk Trees scrolling across various departments

🏢 BUILDINGS:
 Fixed the issue with the marketing building texture not refreshing after closing the PR panel
 Fixed the issue with exclamation marks not appearing when there’s a new building that can be constructed
 Lights in buildings no longer work during daytime
 Fixed the issue whereby players had to click RMB to be able to select buildings after loading the game from the in-game menu
 The Department management menu can no longer be opened while in the Building mode
 Fixed the Building Process information updates in the Buildings Map
 Fixed the issue with buildings not changing their status after clicking the ”Build” button on consecutive game launches 

📌 OTHER:
 Fixed the bug displaying the wrong background (Space Atlas) when entering the Assembly from Mission Control
 Fixed the issue with planets' details disappearing when zooming too close in the Mission Control window
 Fixed the issue with the Department Efficiency not refreshing correctly
 Corrected one of the Investor’s Best Player Bonus information
 Hid notifications from the Rocket Launch window
 Fixed the issue with email notifications overlapping with the rocket launch screen
 Corrected the Polish translation
 Status bar now updates correctly
 Fixed the issue with positive traits displaying in red
 Fixed the issue with the loan time displaying incorrectly in the Finance>Loans card
 And more!

Keep giving us awesome ideas and suggestions on Steam and Discord. Thank you all for helping us make this update happen. If you like the changes, please consider dropping us a review on Steam—we’d love to hear what you think!

Stay on course and aim for the stars!

notes.title: New update available! - Satellites & achievements
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/b1e6e97543fa953fc3deb70b176a682d54d201a7.jpg

Dear Space CEOs!The new Space Company Simulator update is here! You can now enjoy the long-awaited Satellites and get achievements. You can find more information about the new features and improvements as well as a detailed changelog below.

WARNING! Old saves may not work!

Watch the trailer:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q_vplxbtLGc
AchievementsYou can now earn achievements for your hard work! 

Successfully launch small rockets to be awarded with the ‘First Step’, ‘Small beginnings’ and ‘Not size, but quantity’ achievements. Discover ‘Space is profitable’ when you hire your 20th lobbyist. Complete contracts, get investor perks and send manned space missions to earn more achievements!

There are 45 achievements waiting for you, so do your best! Aim high and unlock them all.

Learn the details here: Steam Achievements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/e44c15d979d61635786804ea62a67b79778694a0.pngComplete 45 Steam achievements.

SatellitesIt is now possible to attach satellites to the rockets in the Assembly Room and Sandbox Assembly. Take on new contracts and launch satellites into the orbit of one of the planets of our solar system. Deliver the satellite safely to the required position and cash in!

New satellite components include Small, Medium, and Heavy satellites. They are adjusted to different mission lengths.

notes.title: New update is live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/f78ee14d2e5c14ea57377cf6b82a5f049b4dae02.jpg

Dear Space CEOs!The new Space Company Simulator update has been released on Steam. It introduces a brand new Sandbox Assembly, Historical Events, and multiple fixes! You can find more information about the new features and a detailed changelog below.

Sandbox Assembly{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/8e98f96ad8aa585cd1c681f63ffaa13005e1db11.jpg

Running your own space company is not an easy job. Taking care of finances and planning can consume plenty of time. Have you ever wondered what it would be like to have unlimited resources and just focus on assembling rockets?

With the new Sandbox Assembly, you can experiment with various rocket setups. Choose any of the available blueprints and buy any components you want. When price is no longer an issue, you can get components of the highest rarity without consulting your financial advisors. With unlimited resources, you can launch an unlimited number of rockets!

You can enter this mode from the main menu (“Sandbox Assembly”). You will be directed straight to the assembly.

Historical Events{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34306602/71c1302b29f5dd49d6a43ac538710ccc0daaae31.jpg

Space exploration events are among the most important in humankind’s history. We want to appreciate and celebrate them, so we added the Historical Events feature which introduces crucial milestones of space exploration. Special tooltips are now displayed after hovering over the star icon on the top navigation panel. The events do not affect the gameplay but serve as great reminders that you and your company can accomplish great things too.

Thank you for your help in making this update happen! Please continue sharing your fantastic ideas and suggestions with us. We look forward to hearing from you on Steam and Discord.

Also, if you’re satisfied with the changes, please consider dropping us a review on Steam. They help other space explorers learn more about the game and give us a chance to hear from the players who know SCS best.

notes.title: Release Date & Early Access
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We know we’ve kept you waiting for the release date announcement for too long, but the time has finally come for the big news. Space Company Simulator will be released in Early Access on October 24, 2019.

We are aware that there are two things we need to address.

Firstly, we have missed the scheduled Q3 release. We are all putting in overtime to deliver the best space company management experience we can and we believe that these extra couple of weeks will allow us to launch a game we will all be satisfied with. After all, a delayed game is eventually good, a bad game is bad forever, as Shigeru Miyamoto once said.

Secondly, we have decided to release the game in Early Access. Although we have stated that the development can be tackled without Early Access, we would like to take advantage of such a possibility and seek your feedback before we put the Version 1.0 label on it. While in Early Access, the game will be updated continuously based on your suggestions and reports. Help us make Space Company Simulator the game we all want to play.

We’d like to thank you for your patience and support. You can expect more news from us as we approach the October 24 release.

See you in the stars,
INTERMARUM & All in! Games
